name: Open Exchange
description: Swap 1Color tokens against the pools on this exchange, and deploy and close liquidity positions.

groupPermissions.description: Open Exchange builds swaps and pools with your wallet, holds the tokens on their way into a swap, and receives the sats pools pay you; your tokens themselves are read and sent through your wallet's 1Color module, which asks you each time.

protocolPermissions.description: Derive one-time keys for the sats pools pay you, and for your LP position (BRC-29 payments to yourself).
Derive one-time keys for the tokens held in the swap basket, and sign the swap legs that spend them.
Show which wallet is connected and name it as the sender of payments to yourself.
Create and check the session nonces of authenticated requests to the overlay instance.
Sign authenticated requests to the overlay instance (asked once per instance, on first use).
Label the swaps you build, their funding and their payouts so they are listed together in your wallet.
Label the pools you create so they are listed together in your wallet.
Label the positions you close so they are listed together in your wallet.
Label the pool payouts your wallet takes in so they are listed together.

basketAccess.description: File the tokens sent into the swap basket for your swap legs, spend them in the legs, and move them back into your wallet.
File and read the pools you hold as LP, and drop one when you close it.
File the exact funding output of each swap under a short hold, and drop it once the swap has spent it.
